title: Dhwani TTS HD Update
short_msg: Auto language switching & HD loudness booster enabled! Double tap for details.
full_msg:
Welcome to the new Dhwani TTS by Interested Technology for Blind!

1. Zero-latency automatic language switching (Hindi, English, Marathi, Telugu, Malayalam & more).
2. Crystal clear HD loudness without distortion.
3. Live 0% to 100% voice download progress bar.
4. Full support for Auto TTS, external apps, and games.
update_notes: Version 1.7.0 is live with Auto Language Switching, HD Loudness Booster, and Live Download Progress!
